title: v.clone() pattern repeated 20+ times when serde_json::from_value borrows
description: Throughout email.rs, mailbox.rs, submission.rs: every serde_json::from_value(v.clone()) clones the JSON value before deserializing. serde_json 1.x provides from_str/from_slice as alternatives, but the idiomatic fix for already-parsed JSON is from_value which consumes, not clones. Pattern: args.get('filter').map(|v| serde_json::from_value(v.clone())) — if args is owned or the value can be taken, use args.remove('filter') instead to avoid the clone. Where args must remain intact (e.g. reading multiple fields), a single clone of the subtree is unavoidable, but currently each field does its own clone. Impact: allocations proportional to JSON payload size on every method call.
